services.name: Tea Discovery Class
services.desc: The Steedman Family used gathering spaces throughout Casa del Herrero for afternoon teas to enjoy worldly discussions with family and friends. Our afternoon tea programming honors that timeless tradition in new and exciting ways! This is a great opportunity to fall in love with loose leaf tea! Join in this light-hearted exploration where you will gain uncommon tea knowledge while experiencing some of the most naturally fragrant, aromatic and exquisite teas from around the world. In this 1.5 hour class you will experience first hand the magic of rare, artisan teas you never knew existed. services.name: Golden Hour Sound Bath
services.desc: May this be an opportunity for you to take a sacred pause to relax and rejuvenate! Sound therapy is an ancient meditative practice that uses instruments to create healing vibrations around and within the body to encourage a meditative state. Resounding vibrations come from instruments like crystal sound bowls, chimes, drums, and gongs are received by your body to restore your state of harmony. The resonating energy centers you and allows you to connect, transform, and restore your mind and body on many levels, including feeling creative, revelations, new ideas, improved sleep, a state of peace, lightness, and connection to self. services.name: Sip & Paint Workshop
services.desc: Get up close and personal with paint and wine at Casa del Herrero! Sip & Paint Workshops by Danielle Renée Art are unlike any other experience in Santa Barbara. No painting experience? No worries, we're just here to have fun and throw some paint around! Danielle’s easy, step-by-step instruction and assistance will be available to all attendees throughout the program. In this sip & paint workshop, attendees will create a magical Casa del Herrero spring garden scene with acrylic paint on canvas and taste several local wine varietals during the program. services.desc: Join us for our first hands-on cooking class at our historic property! Guests will enjoy a unique culinary adventure celebrating the art of using homegrown seasonal ingredients.
